Onions are sensitive to their predecessors: they give the highest yields in a rotation and much lower yields when grown continuously or as a monoculture. The best predecessors for bulb onions are winter cereals, pulses, tomatoes and potatoes, early and mid-season cabbage, cucumbers, courgettes and other cucurbits. Onions can return to the same field after 4–5 years. Crops that clear the field late are undesirable. In any case, after the previous crop the soil should be treated with GREENODIN GRAY to turn crop residues into humus.

Liming the soil is important for getting maximum productivity from bulb onions, as they do not tolerate high soil acidity. Удобрение органического репчатого лука: идеальное комплексное решение — органическое удобрение GREENODIN GRAY.

Ordinary organic fertilizers such as manure, compost and vermicompost, applied at 20–40 t/ha, should be used very carefully in organic bulb onion production, as they can cause excessive leafy growth and smaller bulbs. Fertilizing organic bulb onions: the ideal solution is GREENODIN GRAY organic fertilizer.

Growing organic onions from seed is a great way to get healthy, tasty onions without synthetic pesticides or fertilizers. Support the plants with GREENODIN GRAY organic fertilizer. Sowing dates and methods: sow onion seed as soon as the soil is workable, even during the so-called February and March windows. Sowing 3–5 days late can lead to patchy emergence, poor ripening and lower yields. Bulb onions react badly to the topsoil drying out, which is why timing matters so much.

Рекомендованная густота — 800–1300 тыс. растений/га, а для самых крупных луковиц — 600–800 тыс. растений/га. Основные способы посева — широкорядный с междурядьями 45 см и широкополосный 60 см. Схема посева зависит от сеялок: например, 4 строчки с междурядьем 25 см (4 × 25 см) и 50 см между грядками или 6 × 18 + 70 см (6 строчек через 18 см и 70 см между грядками).

Seeding depth is 0.5–3 cm. The seeding rate is 8–10 kg/ha, or 3–4 kg/ha with precision drills. The recommended plant density is 800,000–1,300,000 plants/ha, or 600,000–800,000 plants/ha for the largest bulbs. The main sowing methods are wide rows 45 cm apart and wide bands 60 cm apart. The pattern depends on the drill: for example, 4 rows 25 cm apart (4 × 25 cm) with 50 cm between beds, or 6 × 18 + 70 cm (6 rows 18 cm apart with 70 cm between beds).

Важная часть ухода — борьба с вредителями (луковая моль, клещи, трипсы) и болезнями (ложная мучнистая роса, альтернариоз, гнили). Caring for bulb onion crops. Fields are rolled before and after sowing. When a crust forms, harrow lightly at right angles to the rows. Inter-row cultivation is also used to destroy weeds. Soil-applied and selective herbicides are also used for weed control. Pest control (leek moth, mites, thrips) and disease control (downy mildew, alternaria, rots) are an important part of crop care. Watering bulb onions: irrigation is often used to get maximum productivity.
1642: В южных районах число поливов может доходить до 2–7 и даже 8–12, а норма поливной воды — 300–500 м³/га и даже до 5000 м³/га. Последний полив проводят за 20–30 дней до уборки. Луку нужна постоянная влага в течение вегетации: обильно поливайте раз в неделю или чаще в засуху.

In southern areas, onions may need 2–7 and even 8–12 irrigations, with 300–500 m³/ha and up to 5,000 m³/ha of water. The last watering is 20–30 days before harvest. Onions need constant moisture throughout the season, so water thoroughly once a week, or more often in dry spells.

Для обеззараживания от возбудителей болезней (шейковой гнили и пероноспороза) за 8 часов до окончания прогрева температуру повышают до 40–43 °C.

Growing bulb onions from sets. Organic onions can be grown efficiently by planting small bulbs (0.7–3.0 cm in diameter) raised the previous year. This method is typical of colder regions or for early crops. Five to six days before planting, the sets are graded and warmed at 30–35 °C. To disinfect them against pathogens such as neck rot and downy mildew, the temperature is raised to 40–43 °C for the last 8 hours of warming.
1644: Цель этого способа — более ранний урожай и лучшая товарность продукции при коротком вегетационном периоде. Севок сажают при технической спелости почвы, чтобы эффективно использовать запасы влаги. Сроки посадки очень важны: ранняя посадка при затяжной холодной весне влияет на дифференциацию почек, а в итоге — на массовость стрелкования.

The goal of this method is an earlier harvest and better marketable quality with a shorter growing season. Sets are planted when the soil is workable so that moisture reserves are used efficiently. Timing is crucial: early planting during a long, cold spring affects bud differentiation, which ultimately determines how many plants bolt.

Лучшие сроки посадки севка — при температуре почвы 9–10 °C, или через 10–15 суток после посева семян лука. Late planting is often accompanied by the topsoil drying out, which hinders root development and downward growth, leading to uneven emergence, delayed ripening and lower yield and quality. The best time to plant onion sets is when the soil reaches 9–10 °C, or 10–15 days after sowing onion seed. Sets are planted in bands or wide strips, 4–8 cm apart in the row depending on their size.

The planting rate is 70–90 kg/ha in bands and 50–70 kg/ha in wide strips. Sets are lifted when 5–10% of the foliage has fallen over. In wet years, lifting starts before the foliage falls, once the bulbs are 1.0–1.5 cm across. Weed control in onions: there are several options that can be used together or separately.

Mulching bulb onions is a great way to suppress weeds around the plants. Use organic materials such as straw, leaves or grass clippings to cover the soil around the onions. This keeps the soil moist and cool, which also benefits the onions.

Hand weeding is another effective way to control weeds in an onion bed. Take the time to carefully pull out weeds by the roots before they spread.

Hoeing is a great way to remove weeds while they are still small. Use a sharp hoe to cut weeds just below the soil surface, taking care not to damage the onion plants.

Planting certain companion plants next to onions can help suppress weeds naturally. Good companions for onions include marigolds, basil and chamomile.

Some organic herbicides are available for weed control. They are usually made from natural ingredients such as vinegar or citrus oil. Always read and follow the label instructions carefully before using any herbicide.
1656: Помните: борьба с сорняками — непрерывный процесс, поэтому важно оставаться внимательным и регулярно пропалывать весь сезон.
Remember that weed control is an ongoing job, so stay vigilant and keep up with weeding throughout the season.

Onions are ready to harvest when the tops start to yellow and fall over. The main sign of full maturity is a softening neck and falling foliage. Lift the onions carefully and leave them in a warm, dry place for a few weeks before storing. The mobile silicon in GREENODIN makes the plants sturdier, but onions are still delicate, so handle them with care.
1659: Убирают в солнечную погоду, формируя валки для просушки. Если во время уборки идут дожди, сушат под навесами. Для ускорения созревания за 10–15 дней до уборки подрезают корни. Harvest in sunny weather, laying the onions in windrows to dry. If it rains during harvest, dry them under cover. To speed up ripening, the roots are undercut 10–15 days before harvest. After drying, trim off the remaining leaves and roots, grade the bulbs and store them in well-ventilated stores at 5–8 °C and 60–70% relative humidity.

Органические удобрения GREENODIN очень эффективны для обработки почвы после уборки: в них есть полезные микроорганизмы (бактерии и грибы), которые хорошо разлагают остатки и подавляют патогенную флору. Они превращают органическое вещество в гумус — основу питания растений.

Onion crop residues. GREENODIN organic fertilizers are very effective for treating the soil after harvest, as they contain beneficial microorganisms (bacteria and fungi) that break down residues efficiently and suppress pathogenic flora. These microorganisms decompose organic matter and turn it into humus, the foundation of plant nutrition.
1662: Правильное хранение органического лука важно для его сохранности и качества. Рекомендации: держите лук сухим — влага его враг и вызывает быстрое гниение. После уборки дайте луку просохнуть несколько дней в хорошо проветриваемом месте, пока наружная шелуха не станет бумажной. Не храните вместе с другими продуктами: лук выделяет этилен, из-за которого другие фрукты и овощи быстро портятся.

Proper storage is important for keeping organic onions in good condition for longer. Follow these recommendations: keep them dry, as moisture is the onion's enemy and causes rapid rot. After harvest, let the onions dry for a few days in a well-ventilated place until the outer skin turns papery. Store them in a cool, dry place with good air circulation, such as a pantry or cellar, ideally at 0–4 °C. Avoid storing them with other produce, as onions release ethylene gas, which can make other fruit and vegetables spoil quickly.
1663: Поэтому лук лучше хранить отдельно. Не храните репчатый лук в полиэтиленовых пакетах: ему нужно дышать, иначе он задохнется и испортится, поэтому лучше использовать сетки или хорошо проветриваемый контейнер. Регулярно проверяйте лук на признаки порчи — мягкие пятна или плесень — и сразу удаляйте испорченные луковицы, чтобы они не испортили остальные.

So it is best to store onions separately. Do not store bulb onions in plastic bags; onions need to breathe or they will suffocate and spoil, so use mesh bags or a well-ventilated container. Check your onions regularly for signs of spoilage such as soft spots or mould, and remove any spoiled bulbs straight away so they do not affect the rest.
